commitResults.messageTitle: DG: Complete the positional parser inventory
commitResults.messageBody:
The parser overview omits find from its command table, while the
accompanying diagram says that there are nine concrete command pairs.
The application supports eleven, so the overview gives maintainers an
incomplete and inconsistent map of the parser layer.

Add the find parser and command to the table, update the legend to eleven
pairs, and regenerate the embedded diagram to keep its source and image
consistent.

Fixes #186
DG: Complete the positional parser inventory
